name: harristeeter-mcp
description: Harris Teeter for Claude — groceries, cart, pickup, coupons, weekly ad, recipes, lists, Order Ahead and pharmacy

tools.name: ht_search_products
tools.description: Search Harris Teeter groceries at your pickup store, with prices and stock

tools.name: ht_get_products
tools.description: Look up products by UPC: price, sale price, size and pickup stock

tools.name: ht_get_cart
tools.description: Show the cart with names, prices and an estimated subtotal

tools.name: ht_add_to_cart
tools.description: Add groceries to the cart by UPC

tools.name: ht_update_cart_item
tools.description: Set an item's quantity or substitution preference

tools.name: ht_remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove items from the cart

tools.name: ht_get_store
tools.description: Show the pickup store this account shops at

tools.name: ht_list_timeslots
tools.description: List available pickup windows and fees for the cart

tools.name: ht_start_checkout
tools.description: Reserve a pickup window and create the checkout (you place the order on harristeeter.com)

tools.name: ht_get_checkout
tools.description: Show the checkout draft: items, window, fees, tax, total and the place-order link

tools.name: ht_list_orders
tools.description: List past purchases and receipts

tools.name: ht_list_upcoming_orders
tools.description: List orders placed but not yet picked up

tools.name: ht_get_receipt
tools.description: Read one purchase: items, prices paid, savings and totals

tools.name: ht_list_coupons
tools.description: List e-VIC digital coupons, available or clipped

tools.name: ht_clip_coupon
tools.description: Load a digital coupon to your card

tools.name: ht_unclip_coupon
tools.description: Remove a clipped digital coupon from your card

tools.name: ht_list_specials
tools.description: Your personalised My Specials sale items

tools.name: ht_get_weekly_ad
tools.description: This week's weekly ad by department

tools.name: ht_get_fuel_points
tools.description: Fuel points balance, earned, redeemed and expiring

tools.name: ht_search_recipes
tools.description: Search recipes by keyword

tools.name: ht_get_recipe
tools.description: A recipe's ingredients, steps and matching store products

tools.name: ht_list_shopping_lists
tools.description: Your shopping lists

tools.name: ht_get_shopping_list
tools.description: One shopping list with its items

tools.name: ht_create_shopping_list
tools.description: Create a shopping list

tools.name: ht_rename_shopping_list
tools.description: Rename a shopping list

tools.name: ht_delete_shopping_list
tools.description: Delete a shopping list (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: ht_oa_list_departments
tools.description: Order Ahead departments: deli, subs, pizza, platters, bakery, holiday meals

tools.name: ht_oa_list_menu
tools.description: Order Ahead menu for a department

tools.name: ht_oa_get_item
tools.description: One Order Ahead item with options

tools.name: ht_oa_list_pickup_times
tools.description: Order Ahead pickup times for a date

tools.name: ht_oa_place_order
tools.description: Place an Order Ahead order, paid at pickup (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: ht_rx_session
tools.description: Check the pharmacy session (separate sign-in with a one-time code)

tools.name: ht_rx_list_prescriptions
tools.description: List prescriptions: status, refills remaining, due dates, price

tools.name: ht_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the fetchproxy browser-bridge connection

harristeeter_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
harristeeter_ws_port.description: Override the fetchproxy concentrator port (default 37149). The whole fetchproxy fleet shares 37149 and the ContextMint Bridge extension dials that one port, so change this only if you know why.

harristeeter_debug.title: Debug logging
harristeeter_debug.description: Set to 1 for verbose bridge logging to stderr.

mcp_user_tz.title: Time zone
mcp_user_tz.description: IANA time zone sent with pickup-time requests (default America/New_York).
